objective: Fix audit finding: HIGH: `verify-install.sh` creates a fixture `policy.toml` (`watch_roots = ["$REPO"]`) but never wires it into the binary — `repos --json` runs without `DRACON_SYNC_POLICY` (the env the code honors, policy.rs:1400) and `repos` has no `--policy` flag; the check actually asserts `rows[0]` of the operator's REAL fleet reports `untracked==0`, passing today only because the fleet is clean and false-failing whenever a legitimately-dirty fleet repo is row 0. One-line fix: `DRACON_SYNC_POLICY="$TMP/policy.toml" "$BIN" repos --json` (dracon-sync/scripts/verify-install.sh:47-69) —
verificationContract: the fix is committed on the current branch with the repo's configured identity, and this finding's box in .pi-glla/audit-loop/findings.md is checked ("- [x] … — fixed in <commit>").
